## Auto-update

GitHub Actions runs `.github/workflows/daily-snapshot.yml` on a daily cron. You can also trigger it manually from the Actions tab.

Each run pulls the latest guild member list, updates each member's investment history in `data/members.json`, and refreshes `data/guild-members.json`.
